records.context: how a timm backbone's input is prepared. ``"pretrained"`` resizes each extracted image region to the model's pretrained input size and standardises it by the model's pretrained mean and standard deviation (ImageNet's for ImageNet weights), as the model was trained. ``"none"`` feeds the [0, 1] extracted image regions at their own size. Foundation and DINO encoders prepare their own input and ignore it.
records.label: spacr.embeddings.EmbeddingSpec#12
records.source: how a timm backbone's input is prepared. ``"pretrained"`` resizes each crop to the model's pretrained input size and standardises it by the model's pretrained mean and standard deviation (ImageNet's for ImageNet weights), as the model was trained. ``"none"`` feeds the [0, 1] crops at their own size. Foundation and DINO encoders prepare their own input and ignore it.
records.translation: timm 백본의 입력을 준비하는 방식. ``"pretrained"`` 는 모델이 학습된 방식대로 각 크롭을 모델의 사전 학습 입력 크기로 조정하고 모델의 사전 학습 평균과 표준편차(ImageNet 가중치에서는 ImageNet의 값)로 표준화합니다. ``"none"`` 은 [0, 1] 크롭을 원래 크기 그대로 넣습니다. 파운데이션 인코더와 DINO 인코더는 입력을 스스로 준비하며 이 값을 무시합니다.

records.context: three channel means replacing the pretrained ones.
records.label: spacr.embeddings.EmbeddingSpec#13
records.source: three channel means replacing the pretrained ones.
records.translation: 사전 학습 평균을 대체하는 채널 평균 세 개.

records.context: three positive standard deviations replacing the pretrained ones.
records.label: spacr.embeddings.EmbeddingSpec#14
records.source: three positive standard deviations replacing the pretrained ones.
records.translation: 사전 학습 표준편차를 대체하는 양수 표준편차 세 개.

records.context: side, in pixels, each extracted image region is resized to instead of the pretrained input size; ``0`` keeps the extracted image region size. A backbone with a fixed patch grid is always resized to that grid.
records.label: spacr.embeddings.EmbeddingSpec#15
records.source: side, in pixels, each crop is resized to instead of the pretrained input size; ``0`` keeps the crop size. A backbone with a fixed patch grid is always resized to that grid.
records.translation: 사전 학습 입력 크기 대신 각 크롭을 맞출 한 변의 길이(픽셀). ``0`` 은 크롭 크기를 유지합니다. 고정된 패치 격자를 가진 백본은 항상 그 격자에 맞게 크기가 조정됩니다.

records.context: when ``channel_policy`` is not one of :data:`CHANNEL_POLICIES`, ``batch_size`` is below one, or ``channel_scale`` is set without ``normalize``, holds a negative or non-finite value, or does not give one value per channel in ``channels``; or when the input transform is unknown, a mean or standard deviation is not three finite numbers (the deviations positive), ``input_size`` is negative, or an override is given with the transform switched off.
records.label: spacr.embeddings.EmbeddingSpec.__post_init__#2
records.source: when ``channel_policy`` is not one of :data:`CHANNEL_POLICIES`, ``batch_size`` is below one, or ``channel_scale`` is set without ``normalize``, holds a negative or non-finite value, or does not give one value per channel in ``channels``; or when the input transform is unknown, a mean or standard deviation is not three finite numbers (the deviations positive), ``input_size`` is negative, or an override is given with the transform switched off.
records.translation: ``channel_policy`` 가 :data:`CHANNEL_POLICIES` 중 하나가 아니거나, ``batch_size`` 가 하나보다 작거나, ``channel_scale`` 이 ``normalize`` 없이 설정되었거나 음수 또는 유한하지 않은 값을 담고 있거나 ``channels`` 의 채널마다 값을 하나씩 주지 않을 때. 또는 입력 변환을 알 수 없거나, 평균 또는 표준편차가 유한한 수 세 개가 아니거나(표준편차는 양수), ``input_size`` 가 음수이거나, 변환을 끈 상태에서 대체 값이 주어졌을 때.

records.context: Embed an extracted image region store into per-cell embeddings and per-microplate sample position aggregates.
records.label: spacr.embeddings.embed_store#0
records.source: Embed a crop store into per-cell embeddings and per-well aggregates.
records.translation: 크롭 저장소를 세포별 임베딩과 웰별 집계로 임베딩합니다.

records.context: One fixed scale per channel is estimated from a random sample of the whole store (the 99th percentile of 2,048 extracted image regions) and every extracted image region is divided by it, so a cell's embedding does not depend on which extracted image regions share its batch. The extracted image regions are encoded in chunks on CPU worker processes, then averaged per microplate sample position: the mean and the median of every dimension, with the number of cells.
records.label: spacr.embeddings.embed_store#1
records.source: One fixed scale per channel is estimated from a random sample of the whole store (the 99th percentile of 2,048 crops) and every crop is divided by it, so a cell's embedding does not depend on which crops share its batch. The crops are encoded in chunks on CPU worker processes, then averaged per well: the mean and the median of every dimension, with the number of cells.
records.translation: 채널마다 고정된 스케일 하나를 저장소 전체의 무작위 표본(크롭 2,048개의 99번째 백분위수)에서 추정하고 모든 크롭을 그 값으로 나누므로, 세포의 임베딩은 어떤 크롭과 같은 배치에 들어가는지에 좌우되지 않습니다. 크롭은 CPU 작업 프로세스에서 청크 단위로 인코딩된 뒤 웰별로 평균됩니다. 즉 모든 차원의 평균과 중앙값을 세포 수와 함께 구합니다.

records.context: a ``measurements.db`` (extracted image regions chosen by ``object_type``, ``plate`` and ``where``, read as the Embeddings application view reads them), a :class:`spacr.crop_loader.CropQuery`, a ``.npy`` extracted image region array (opened memory-mapped), or any ``(n, height, width, channels)`` array that can be sliced, such as an HDF5 dataset.
records.label: spacr.embeddings.embed_store#2
records.source: a ``measurements.db`` (crops chosen by ``object_type``, ``plate`` and ``where``, read as the Embeddings screen reads them), a :class:`spacr.crop_loader.CropQuery`, a ``.npy`` crop array (opened memory-mapped), or any ``(n, height, width, channels)`` array that can be sliced, such as an HDF5 dataset.
records.translation: ``measurements.db`` (``object_type``, ``plate``, ``where`` 로 크롭을 고르며 Embeddings 화면과 같은 방식으로 읽음), :class:`spacr.crop_loader.CropQuery`, ``.npy`` 크롭 배열(메모리 매핑으로 열림), 또는 HDF5 데이터셋처럼 슬라이스할 수 있는 임의의 ``(n, height, width, channels)`` 배열.

records.translation: 임베딩 방법. 기본값은 채널별 resnet18입니다. ``channel_scale`` 을 담은 명세는 그대로 사용됩니다.
